transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for joining. As part of the normal approval routine for the peer-feedback pilot, I'd like to do a round-robin check-in before we finalize the plan. The proposal currently covers facilitated discussion, ordinary participation, and a post-pilot review — but before I sign off, I want to make sure we define the detailed operating safeguards together. Given the tense exchanges in recent retrospectives, getting this right matters. Who'd like to start?
